title: The Paymaster's Box
summary: Brannoc says the Redhand's paymaster kept the robed strangers' coin at the Tithe Mill, in two boxes, because he trusted nobody, himself included. Brannoc wants to see whose seal is on the purses.

steps.journal: Open two chests in the Tithe Mill, up the river from Thornwick.

ready: Tell Brannoc it's done: tap his party card, then Talk.
done: The paymaster's boxes at the Tithe Mill: coal-red wax on every purse, no crest. Brannoc kept one seal.
